import-game-dd-wy-commando side 1: physical latch without relocation, extra cost or changed body scale
import-game-dd-guardian side 0: physical latch without relocation, extra cost or changed body scale

the leap closes to the physical contact gap instead of restraining at generic reach
a ranged miss neither creates a grapple nor delays an unrelated round
a xenomorph takes the existing Prowler impact, never a human restraint
frontal guard prevents a restraint and keeps its original chip/cost contract
an airborne human cannot be held on the floor by a remote grab
a real light contact interrupts the preparation before a restraint begins
a lethal initial contact ends the round, without restraining a corpse
one restraint causes three bounded DOT ticks, not four direct hits or endless damage
held actions cannot move either actor, attack, jump, refill stamina or create a super while restrained
holding guard escapes without mash, stamina costs or damage immunity
releasing guard resets incomplete escape progress
pause freezes restraint, damage and escape; the held guard must rearm after resume
controls held during escape do not replay as an opening attack or movement afterwards
a projectile in flight can hit the captor and release both actors without refund
external physical separation releases a restraint rather than snapping the target back
an already dead captor releases without any further DOT or corpse damage
DOT overkill counts only the remaining HP and cannot pay a second round
no-special disables admission and releases an existing restraint
round timeout removes restraints and the next round rebuilds independent actors
CPU gains a real restraint from the default starting positions
CPU victim reads the visible hold and escapes through the same guard input
the complete restraint serializes identically at 30/60/120Hz
a JSON snapshot resumes a bounded restraint without new damage/capture IDs
rendering and accessible view never mutate the authoritative simulation
existing historical attack numerics and super admission are not rewritten for the roster
